task.title: AI support platform migration
task.scenario: A B2B SaaS company must decide whether to migrate 40 percent of its support workflow to an AI triage platform before the holiday traffic spike.

Engineering can spare only two developers for six weeks.
Support leadership needs a customer communication plan.
Compliance needs an auditable escalation path for every automated decision.
Customer Success wants different messaging for enterprise and self-serve cohorts.

Security review found no critical blockers, but audit logging needs extra work.

Executive Summary

We recommend proceeding with a staged rollout to migrate 40 percent of our support workflows to the AI triage platform before the upcoming holiday spike. This approach balances operational efficiency gains, fiscal responsibility, and risk mitigation to preserve our enterprise Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

Financial Case

The AI triage pilot resolved 27 percent of tier-1 tickets without human escalation, supporting a forecasted 15 percent reduction in support headcount cost and improved handling capacity during the 35 percent projected holiday ticket volume spike. The CFO endorses this migration with a payback analysis projecting ROI within nine months, accounting for engineering investment and potential false routing impact.

Implementation Plan

Engineering will allocate two developers for six weeks to implement the migration in three phases: initial pilot expansion to 20 percent of workflow, a performance validation period, then full rollout to 40 percent contingent on meeting SLA performance. This phased approach ensures continuous monitoring, allows tuning of AI routing algorithms, and incorporates compliance logging enhancements.

- SLA Breach Risk: Increased false routing from 3.1% to 5.4% during the pilot presents a risk to current median first response SLA of 11 minutes with a 30-minute breach threshold. Mitigation includes close monitoring, dynamic fallback to human triage, and rollback triggers if SLA degradation exceeds 5% over baseline.
